QuestInfo.name: The Kerning City Book Store Owner 2
QuestInfo.0: According to Mr. Pickall, Jeppi is in Ellinia...
QuestInfo.1: Jeppi seems to be living by the #bGiant Tree#k in the forest near Ellinia. Go find him.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Jeppi, but the Dark Lord's minions were there, too. Was the Dark Lord trying to off Jeppi? But Jeppi's reaction doesn't seem to suggest that...

0.0: This is wonderful, simply delightful. If we can convince Jeppi to speak of the Dark Lord's corruption, the citizens of Kerning City will turn against him and the Dual Blades can make our move. Head to the #bGiant Tree#k outside #bElinia#k and talk to Jeppi. Quickly, now.\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to the Giant Tree in Ellinia when you accept.)#n

no.0: Have you been a traitor all this time? I don't deal lightly with traitors...

1.0: W-who are you? What do you want? Please don't hurt me like you hurt my friends!\r\n#L0##b(Jeppi must be in shock. You assure him that you're not his enemy.)#l\n#k
1.1: Not my enemy? Then why did you hurt those men that the Dark Lord sent to protect me?!\r\n#L0##b(Something fishy's going on here. Doesn't the Dark Lord hate Jeppi?)#l\n#k
1.2: Why don't you put your weapons away and sit down, and we can talk about this calmly. Please!

npc.0: Why haven't you gone to find #bJeppi#k at the #bGiant Tree#k near #bEllinia#k yet? The sooner we get his testimony, the sooner we can strike the Dark Lord!

mob.0: W-who are you?! What do you want? Please don't hurt me!
